text: 卖婬合法会让强奸变少的结论是怎么得出来的？
en: How was the conclusion that legalising prostitution would reduce rape arrived at?

text: 通过纵容一种违法行为去减少另一种违法行为，这不是脑子有病吗？
en: To reduce one illegal act by tolerating another illegal act — is that not utterly deranged?

text: 【提醒】
en: [Reminder]

text: 首先，我们要界定合法、不违法、违法，这三者的区别：
en: First, we must define the distinction between legal, not illegal, and illegal:

text: ①合法：法律条文中明确写明，你能做这件事，并且有详细的法律程序。
en: ① Legal: the law explicitly states that you may do this, and there are detailed legal procedures.

text: ②违法：法律条文中明确写明，你不能做这件事。
en: ② Illegal: the law explicitly states that you may not do this.

text: 如果你做了，后续会有什么样的处罚。
en: If you do it, what kind of punishment will follow.

text: ③不违法：法律条文中既不明确写明你能做这件事，也不明确写明你不能做这件事。
en: ③ Not illegal: the law neither explicitly states that you may do this, nor explicitly states that you may not do this.

text: 法律条文中完全不提及这件事。
en: The law makes absolutely no mention of this matter.

text: 【拉回现实】
en: [Back to reality]

text: 现在的情况是这样的：
en: The current situation is as follows:

text: ①性服务，1女对1男（1女先后为多男服务），按 小时/次 收费，违法。
en: ① Sexual services, one woman to one man (one woman serves multiple men in succession), charged by the hour/per session, illegal.

text: ②包养，1女对1男，按 天/月 收费，不违法。
en: ② Being kept, one woman to one man, charged by the day/month, not illegal.

text: ③约泡，1女对1男（1女先后和多男约泡），不付钱，不违法。
en: ③ Casual hook-ups, one woman to one man (one woman has casual hook-ups with multiple men in succession), no money exchanged, not illegal.

text: ④结婚，1女对1男，男方要支付彩礼房车，合法，有一定的法律程序，持证。
en: ④ Marriage, one woman to one man, the man must pay bride price, a house and a car, legal, there are certain legal procedures, with a certificate.

text: （女方可以合法诈骗）
en: (The woman may legally commit fraud)

text: ⑤潜规则，1女对1男，男方给女方职务/机会（比如演个女一号），不违法。
en: ⑤ Unwritten rules, one woman to one man, the man gives the woman a position/opportunity (for example, a lead female role), not illegal.

text: 一共5种形态
en: Five forms in total

text: （1）按照逻辑来说：①性服务属于零售、②包养算批发。
en: (1) Speaking logically: ① sexual services are retail, ② being kept counts as wholesale.

text: 如果零售违法，那么批发也是违法。
en: If retail is illegal, then wholesale is also illegal.

text: 但是，在我们这里，神奇的就是零售违法、批发不违法。
en: But here, the absurd thing is that retail is illegal while wholesale is not.

text: 【注：这一点被无数人诟病】
en: [Note: this point has been criticised by countless people]

text: （2）按照传统性观念（道德）来评判：①性服务、②包养、③约泡、⑤潜规则，都是不道德的。
en: (2) Judged by traditional sexual attitudes (morality): ① sexual services, ② being kept, ③ casual hook-ups, ⑤ unwritten rules — all are immoral.

text: 但是，在我们这里，只有①性服务是违法的，其他的都不违法。
en: But here, only ① sexual services are illegal; the others are not illegal.

text: （3）按照男女交换利益的角度来看：①性服务、②包养、④结婚、⑤潜规则，都是一样的，男人要性/生育后代，女人要物质/职位/机会/更好的生活/跨越阶层（比如港姐嫁给富豪、女明星嫁给官员），男女各取所需。
en: (3) From the perspective of men and women exchanging benefits: ① sexual services, ② being kept, ④ marriage, ⑤ unwritten rules are all the same — men want sex/bearing offspring, women want material goods/positions/opportunities/a better life/class transcendence (for example, a Miss Hong Kong marrying a tycoon, a female celebrity marrying an official); each takes what they need.

text: 但是，在我们这里，只有④结婚是合法的，②包养、⑤潜规则是不违法的，①性服务是违法的。
en: But here, only ④ marriage is legal, ② being kept and ⑤ unwritten rules are not illegal, and ① sexual services are illegal.

text: 所以，从逻辑、道德、交换利益三个角度来说，我们这里的法律是完全不能自洽的，是思维错乱的。
en: Therefore, from the three angles of logic, morality, and exchange of benefits, our law here is completely self-contradictory and its thinking is utterly muddled.

text: 为什么逻辑不能自洽，为什么思维如此错乱，我相信这个答案，在座各位看官的心里应该比我更清楚。
en: Why the logic cannot be self-consistent, why the thinking is so muddled — I believe the audience here knows the answer better than I do.

text: 最好的反驳就是把二奶，包养，私生子，艾滋病性病，天价彩礼，骗婚，出轨，权色交易，腐2败消灭掉。
en: The best rebuttal is to eliminate the mistress, being kept, illegitimate children, AIDS and sexually transmitted diseases, sky-high bride prices, marriage fraud, cheating, power-for-sex transactions, and corruption.

text: 新中国建立的时候，是把这些通通消灭掉的。
en: When New China was founded, all of these were eliminated.

text: 如果卖淫非法，包二奶合法，那就是只许州官放火，不许百姓点灯了。
en: If prostitution is illegal but keeping a mistress is legal, then that is a case of 'the magistrate may set fires while the common people may not even light a lamp'.

text: 宗继昌、宗婕莉等宗庆后私生子就是证据，为什么不追究责任？
en: Jichang Zong, Jieli Zong and other illegitimate children of Qinghou Zong are the evidence — why have they not been held accountable?

text: 安全套发明之后，1对1无组织的卖淫直接危害不大。
en: After the invention of the condom, one-on-one unorganised prostitution poses little direct harm.

text: 传染病，非婚生子女问题都可以避免。
en: Infectious diseases and the issue of children born out of wedlock can both be avoided.

text: 相比权色交易危害小多了。
en: Compared with power-for-sex transactions, the harm is far smaller.
